scripts.dev:backend:restart: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$line = netstat -ano | findstr ':4000' | findstr 'LISTENING' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($line) { $procId = [int](($line -split '\s+')[-1]); Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force }; npm --workspace backend run build; $backendDir = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'backend'; $entry = Join-Path $backendDir 'dist\index.js'; Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList $entry -WorkingDirectory $backendDir; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700; try { (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'http://localhost:4000/api/health').Content | Out-Null; Write-Output 'Backend restarted on :4000' } catch { Write-Error 'Backend failed to start on :4000'; exit 1 }"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:bundle:prod: npm --workspace backend run build:bundle && npm --workspace frontend run build:bundle
